why: A check that prints nothing while it works reads as a hang, and somebody who thinks the tool has hung stops it. Checking a folder goes through the same three steps as every scan, riskiest first, and says each finding the moment it is made under the step that made it: the infected build config here is a step 1 file, so it is shown before the project files are read. Into a pipe each step is printed as it starts and ends, and nothing is drawn over (ADR-0059).

must_print: This only reads. Nothing is changed.
print_order: Step 1 of 3  Things that run by themselves
CONFIRMED  a build config carries the payload
Step 3 of 3  Large files against known hashes
